layman_headline: Market is ripping higher but everything looks overheated — patience is the play right now.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market just had a massive week — Bitcoin is up 23%, Ethereum up 30%, and many altcoins are up 30-70%. This kind of explosive move means most coins are stretched far above normal levels and are due for a pullback. Our existing XRP position is down 5% from entry but still above our stop-loss, so we're holding it. Rather than chasing prices that have already surged, we're waiting for a dip to enter new positions at better prices.
layman_action: Do not chase this rally. Hold existing positions with stop-losses in place and wait for a 5-10% pullback before adding new trades. If XRP drops to $1.30, it will be automatically stopped out.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates show negative composite scores due to extreme 7-day moves (30-73%) combined with Greed sentiment (74) and high BTC dominance (59.1%). The market is in a momentum phase following BTC's push toward $80K, but after such vertical moves, mean reversion risk is elevated. SOL is the best watchlist candidate given the deflationary burn catalyst and $5.7B daily volume, but entering after a 30% weekly run with RSI likely well above 70 is poor risk management. XRP position at -5.1% is within tolerance and the $1.85 target remains viable if the broader rally continues. No swing candidates present a favorable entry at current levels.
risk_factors: BTC approaching $80K psychological resistance — rejection here could trigger a broad 10-15% correction across all alts
Fear & Greed at 74 and rising — historically, readings above 75 often precede short-term pullbacks
BTC dominance at 59.1% suggests capital is flowing to BTC first; alts may underperform if dominance continues rising
watch_list: BTC price action around $80,000 resistance — a clean break above or rejection will dictate the next move for all alts
SOL price dipping toward $90-92 support zone which would offer a better swing entry
XRP holding above $1.40 support — if it breaks below, early exit before $1.30 stop-loss may be warranted
market_context: The crypto market is in a powerful rally with BTC up 23% weekly and approaching $80K. Fear & Greed is at 74 (Greed) and improving, but after such an explosive move, the market is extended and vulnerable to a sharp correction.
context_banner: Explosive rally has pushed most assets 20-70% higher in a week — discipline demands waiting for a pullback rather than chasing extended moves.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 74 (Greed) and trending higher from weekly average of 66 — signals elevated euphoria and increased pullback risk.
Bitcoin nearing $80K but analysts explicitly warning the next pullback will be key — validates caution on new entries.
New Solana vote could ramp daily SOL burns to $800K and slow token creation — strong deflationary catalyst makes SOL the top watchlist candidate on a dip.
BTC volume at $51.4B and ETH at $20.2B are extremely elevated, consistent with a climactic move rather than the start of a trend.
Fidelity enabling 100% ETF staking for crypto is structurally bullish medium-term but already priced into the current rally.
